name: Scroll Book
description: Fixed 3D book that scales in and opens page by page as the user scrolls, flipping through chapters, text, figures, quotes and galleries until the back cover.
contents: Front cover with title, subtitle and emblem
Pages array rendered as two-sided leaves: chapter, text, figure, quote, split, gallery and ornament layouts
Back cover with closing text and emblem
behavior: Book scales up from half size at the start of scroll
Each leaf rotates open in 3D, scrubbed to scroll position
Back cover emblem fades in at the end
Book size is based on vmin units with a pixel minimum
editableByProps: All page content, covers, labels and images
Number of leaves and scroll distance per page turn
Book, cover, spine, page and background colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the page flip angle or easing
needsCodeEdit.where: rotateY tween inside the elements.forEach in the useEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change page layouts or add a new page type
Change the start scale of the book

fixed: Adds a tall scroll spacer and pins the book and background in fixed layers, so it should be the main content of the page
Background layer is fixed full screen behind the page
Fonts load through next/font/google (Playfair Display and Lora), which needs Next.js
Page text is sized in vmin, so it is small on narrow phones where the book hits its minimum size
